newsitem.title: USA: Audio King closes Ultimate merger.
newsitem.headline: Audio King closes Ultimate merger.

text.p: Audio King Corp said Friday it completed a proposed merger with Ultimate Electronics Inc following approval by Audio King shareholders at a special meeting.
Under terms of the transaction, Audio King shareholders can elect to have their shares exchanged for either $1.75 per share or to have each share converted to 0.7 share of Ultimate stock.
Also according to terms, 50 percent of the shares will receive Ultimate Electronics stock and 50 percent of the shares will receive cash.
Audio King operates eleven retail stores and a large audio/video electronics repair service.
